text:
alex: Hey team — need a last-minute swap. Flight delayed, can't cover 18:00-02:00 PDT tonight. Can someone take primary? I'll stay reachable as secondary unless something urgent pops.

maya: I can take primary from 19:00–02:00 if that helps. I'm on standby for a deploy at 18:30 though, will that clash?

sam: @maya if the deploy needs a rollback you can handback to me briefly. Otherwise i'm fine to be secondary.

lee: I can shadow from 18:45–22:00. Happy to field P1s while @maya ramps up.

alex: Awesome — thanks. Quick checklist for handoff (copying runbook links):

```
- confirm pager transfer: `pager assign maya`
- notify customers on-call alias if customer-facing incident: `ops-notify`
- export current active incidents: `incident export --open`
- ensure canary rollout watch: console/redwood/canary
- share top-3 watch items: redis queue latency, kv cache error rate, model-variant fallback rate
```

Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Link to pager UI: https://pager.example/teams/redwood-oncall

oncall-bot: Scheduled swap request received for thread 1729502468. Current policy requires primary to be confirmed by 1 person other than the requester. Waiting for confirmation.

maya: Confirmed. I'll be primary from 19:00 PDT. I'll take pager now.

alex: Thanks — assigning pager now...

alex: `> pager assign maya`  (output: success — maya now primary, alex secondary)

oncall-bot: Pager assignment recorded. Notification sent to #eng-oncall and refreshed rota.

tanya: Quick heads up — there's a small spike in customer error rate tied to model X fallback at 18:05, but ingested traces show automatic retry is working. @maya, keep an eye on `/metrics/fallback_rate` and set alert suppression if we see a noisy regression.

maya: Got it, watching fallback_rate and redis.latency. Lee can you keep an eye on logs/traces for any new 5xx? I'll handle escalation if it looks like a model regression.

lee: Yep, watching logs. If anything crosses 5m error rate > 2% i'll page infra.

sam: FYI I added a temporary dashboard panel: https://dashboards.redwood/quick/hand-off

alex: Final checks: I've turned off non-critical deploys for tonight window, and left a note in the incident channel for any incoming on-call to reference current mitigations.

maya: OK i'm fully onboarded. @alex safe travels. :seat_with_belt:

alex: Thanks all. I'll be reachable via DM if needed. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Thread closed for automated reminders. Reminder: handoff must be re-confirmed if primary changes again within 2h."
